cards.explanation: The answer is False. The LORD of Hosts says, "Surely, as I have planned, so will it be; as I have purposed, so will it stand." (Isaiah 14:24) He swears it, and nothing in the oath leaves room for the plan to change. I've signed up for plenty of things, friends, and I changed my mind on half of them by lunchtime. That's not how this oath works.
The answer is break Assyria. The LORD says, "I will break Assyria in My land…" (Isaiah 14:25) Straight to the point, friends, no wiggle room. I like a message that doesn't make me squint.
The answer is on His mountain. The LORD says, "I will trample him on My mountain." (Isaiah 14:25) Notice He says "My." It's His land and His mountain, friends, so the plan plays out on His ground.

The answer is the LORD's people. The LORD says, "His yoke will be taken off My people, and his burden removed from their shoulders." (Isaiah 14:25) A yoke is a heavy wooden beam that rests on the shoulders, so this is about heavy weight coming off. I think that's the kind of news you'd want to hear twice, friends.

The answer is the whole earth. The message says, "This is the plan devised for the whole earth…" (Isaiah 14:26) The message started with one empire and now it's zoomed all the way out, friends. That's a big plan.

The answer is no one can. The questions are "…who can thwart Him?" and "…who can turn it back?" (Isaiah 14:27) Nobody steps up, friends, and that's the point. The LORD of Hosts has purposed, and His hand is outstretched.
